Dear Master,

Regarding e-mail nr-0102, please verify the VLSFO consumption figures for 22 Jan 2025, specifically tank soundings and flow meter readings.

The noon report shows VLSFO consumption of 27.6 t over 24 h against the CP warranted 24 t/day (+15%; 2.4 t). This is 9.5% above the 25.2 t allowed with the 5% "about" tolerance.

Speed 12.5 kn is within warranty (min 12.0 kn). The day was a good weather day (max Beaufort 4, max Douglas 3; CP limits 4 and 3), so weather does not explain the excess fuel and the warranty applies.

We would appreciate your confirmation of the figures at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Operations
